notes: Encoded ONLY from Lifebreath's own page. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (pre-1995, MPAA29100902341) — its year digits are REVERSED, and the page states that from 95-98 both reversed and non-reversed forms were used ('59' reversed or '95' non-reversed both = 1995). A reversed-only encoding would therefore produce known wrong decodes for straight-form 96/97/98 units (e.g. printed '96' read reversed as '69' -> 1969 instead of 1996), and the locked schema has no dual-direction year encoding; the shipped AllStyle Style 1 precedent likewise holds reversed-year styles. Style 1's month (7th & 8th digits) cannot ship without its year, since year is a required field. Style ids keep the page's style-2/style-3 numbering so the held style maps unambiguously.

styles.notes: Page example shown as '000 051696000014209' (space stripped by normalization). Page positions 4th & 5th numerical digits = month, 6th & 7th = day of month, 8th & 9th = year (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open month [3,5] and year [7,9]. All-digit serial, so character and digit counting agree. Day is documented on the page but not encoded (locked schema has no day field). Highlighted page segment '051696' = month 05, day 16, year 96 -> 1996-05.

styles.era: Post-1995, 4 letters + varied digits, date in first six numerical digits
styles.notes: Page example shown as 'MBAH 0920110887' (space stripped by normalization). Page states the month, day and year are the first six numerical digits, in that order: month = 1st & 2nd numerical digits, day = 3rd & 4th, year = 5th & 6th, converted to normalized month [4,6] and year [8,10] (letters occupy indices 0-3). Day is documented but not encoded (no day field). Highlighted page segment '092011' = month 09, day 20, year 11 -> 2011-09. Pattern deliberately excludes exactly 11 trailing digits: that is held Style 1's fixed shape (4 letters + 11 digits), and a Style 1 serial whose year code is 01-12 could otherwise mis-decode under this style; a genuine Style 3 serial of that length reads cannot-determine instead of risking a wrong decode. Disjoint from style-2 (letter-led vs all-digit).
